description: Inspect a Logs API request by request_id (status, parts, size, next step), or omit request_id to list all of the counter's log requests and current storage-quota usage. Poll this after logs_request until status="processed". Read-only.

counterId.description: Yandex Metrica counter id. Optional if YANDEX_METRIKA_COUNTER_ID is configured.

requestId.description: Log request id to inspect. Omit to list all requests and current quota usage.

name: logs_status
title: Check Metrica log requests
